newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport Q1 1997 cargo traffic up 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport Q1 1997 cargo traffic up 4.5 pct.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport in the first quarter of 1997 was up 4.5 percent on the same period last year to 109,764 tonnes, airport authority figures show.

January-March 1997 cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at the airport increased by 2.2 percent on the first three months of 1996 to 60,029 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up 1.8 percent to 19,010 tonnes.
During the period in question, trucked airfreight handled at Zurich Airport rose by 11.3 percent on January-March 1996 to 30,725 tonnes, the airport authority said.
January-March 1997 postal traffic handled at the airport totalled 4,745 tonnes, up 16.8 percent.
